verdict.rationale: Any SaaS that handles customer data could reasonably state whether that data trains AI models, so the axis applies to doola. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. The registered-agent privacy items (hiding a personal address from public databases, a generic 'commitment to privacy protection') are adjacent features and do not address AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
